ports.name: dfmt_enable
ports.description: Data format enable. if this enabled then only the other 2 signal are valid, if `dfmt_enable` is disabled output data will be concatenation of 24 times zero and input `s_axis_data` data.

ports.name: dfmt_type
ports.description: Data format type if `dfmt_type` = 1, then inverted version of `s_axis_data's` MSB will be carry forwarded, and for 0  `s_axis_data's` MSB will be carry forwarded to m_axis_data[23].
